build_ViTCudaGraphRunner: build a ViTCudaGraphRunner instance from a vision transformer module to capture and replay CUDA graphs
create_ViTCudaGraphRunner_graph: create a CUDA graph in ViTCudaGraphRunner for a given input sequence length and position embeddings
run_ViTCudaGraphRunner: run ViTCudaGraphRunner to capture and replay ViT blocks with cu_seqlens and rotary position embeddings
replay_ViTCudaGraphRunner_graph: replay a captured ViTCudaGraphRunner CUDA graph with updated input tensor and rotary embeddings
review_ViTCudaGraphRunner_deepstack: review ViTCudaGraphRunner support for Qwen3-VL deepstack merger and Qwen2.5-VL full attention block indexes
